items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: Interviewer identifies Frankie Keeling as part of the band ('That's Frankie Keeling') in the context of discussing the group members, and Interviewee confirms the lineup ('Playing with your Pete? Yeah. Was it Ike Jackson? Mm-hmm.')

ctx.x: We worked with Frankie Duesen a long time. Frank played in the band together with Frankie.
How was Frankie in those days? Was he pretty rough, or was he smooth playing, or how was he doing?
Rough. Rough as they made him. Really? We had a father now, he would've. He begged me, begged me to come back with him, but I never would go back and play with him. Was he rough?
